text: Protocol v0: specify the .bowman format with a JSON Schema and a validate command
description: Extract the stored format into a written, versioned spec plus JSON Schemas (generated from the shared zod schemas) and a standalone `bowman validate` CLI. It is the core deliverable of the Prototype Fund framing (open Git-native intent protocol for developers), strengthens the application's current baseline, and lets other tools read idea graphs without MCP or the backend.
